claim_boundary: The six target classes yield 646 human-positive images, not 1,503 independent images; one image may carry several positive labels. Of those images, 183 have multiple weapon classes marked positive, so only 274 have exactly one positive foil, epee, or sabre class and 189 have no specific weapon class. These are image-level labels rather than athlete identities, actions, bouts, boxes, or source-video groups. Official validation/test splits are retained, while the 4,894 negative-only images are cataloged as class-specific hard negatives.
image_license_boundary: Open Images documents image-level author and license metadata separately. Images are kept local until each selected row is joined to that metadata; no image redistribution is authorized by the annotation license alone.
